summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments on PR #342 (cipher-box) from automated and human reviewers, implementing valid fixes and dismissing non-applicable ones.
summary.outcome: All 7 unresolved review threads were addressed: planning docs updated, error normalization and totalFailed handling fixed in client.ts, all 61 SDK tests passing, changes committed and pushed, and threads replied to and resolved.

repo: batchPublishIpnsRecords in packages/sdk-core/src/ipns/index.ts returns { totalSucceeded, totalFailed } — callers must guard against undefined return values from mocks in tests.

The project uses a .planning/ directory with structured phases (e.g. 19.2-ipfs-upload-performance-optimization) containing RESEARCH.md, ROADMAP.md, and baselines files that are kept in sync with implementation changes.
console.warn is a pre-existing pattern across 5+ call sites in the SDK — not injectable logger pattern, established convention.
Typed SDK events follow the pattern 'namespace:eventName' (e.g. ipns:batchPublishFailed, share:reWrapFailed).

code.finding: totalFailed access on batchPublishIpnsRecords result must be guarded (e.g. batchResult.value?.totalFailed) because existing test mocks return undefined rather than the full result shape.
batchPublishIpnsRecords return type is { totalSucceeded, totalFailed } — both fields always present in production but mocks may omit them.

workflow: When fixing code that depends on a return value, check existing test mocks — they may not reflect the full return shape, causing test failures after the fix.
GraphQL resolveReviewThread mutation can batch multiple thread resolutions; REST endpoint requires integer comment ID via --field (not -f) for in_reply_to.
Run pnpm typecheck + pnpm test before committing review fixes to catch mock/type mismatches introduced by the changes.

friction: Test mocks for batchPublishIpnsRecords returned undefined instead of { totalSucceeded, totalFailed }, causing 61-test suite failures after the initial fix — required a second edit to add a safe access guard.
Had to distinguish between valid fix needed vs. already addressed vs. not applicable across 7 threads before implementing, requiring reads of multiple planning and source files.
open_items: batchResult.value.totalFailed > 0 without rejection: edge case in the batch API where partial failures are silently swallowed — flagged as a follow-up, not addressed in this PR.
console.warn → injectable logger: pre-existing pattern across 5+ call sites, deferred as out of scope for this PR.
Orphaned IPNS record scenario: only documented with a comment noting the benign orphan case — deeper handling not implemented.
